assignments.description: Sets colISAIds += {!colSubflowCreatedAssignmentIds}; varISACount += {!varSubflowCreatedAssignmentCount}; colExistingISAIds += {!colSubflowExistingAssignmentIds}; varSelectedOutcomeCount = count of {!colSelectedOutcomesForStrategy} - {!varSubflowCreatedAssignmentCount}; varExistingISACount += {!varSelectedOutcomeCount}. Selected minus created is the number of links that already existed. It is worked out this way rather than by counting colExistingISAIds, because the subflow returns that list as null when nothing existed. The count controls the "Some links already existed" notes on the strategy review and Success screens.
assignments.name: asgAppendStrategyAssignmentOutputs
assignments.label: Append Strategy Assignment Outputs

assignments.description: Sets colSummaryISAIds = {!colISAIds}; colSummaryISAIds += {!colExistingISAIds}, so the summary shows both the links created in this session and the links that already existed. The summary looks them up by ID, so an ID in both lists is shown once.
assignments.name: asgBuildSummaryISAIds
assignments.label: Build Summary Assignment IDs

assignments.description: Empties colActivitiesToCreate after the records are saved, so the next outcome in the session starts with an empty queue and nothing is created twice.
assignments.name: asgClearActivitiesToCreate
assignments.label: Clear Activities to Create

assignments.description: Sets varActivityToEdit.BenefitId = {!inpEditActivityBenefit}; varActivityToEdit.ProgramId = {!inpEditActivityProgram}; varActivityToEdit.GoalDefinitionId = {!inpEditActivityGoal}; colActivitiesToUpdate += {!varActivityToEdit}; varActivityEditCount += 1.0.
assignments.name: asgCollectActivity
assignments.label: Collect Edited Activity

assignments.description: Prepares an Outcome Activity linked to the selected Benefit: sets Name, OutcomeActivityType and OutcomeId, sets BenefitId from the repeater row, clears the other two lookups so no value carries over from the previous row, then adds the record to colActivitiesToCreate. Records are saved together by rcCreateActivities after the loop, keeping DML out of the loop.
assignments.name: asgQueueActivityBenefit
assignments.label: Queue Activity (Benefit)

assignments.description: Prepares an Outcome Activity linked to the selected Goal Definition: sets Name, OutcomeActivityType and OutcomeId, sets GoalDefinitionId from the repeater row, clears the other two lookups so no value carries over from the previous row, then adds the record to colActivitiesToCreate. Records are saved together by rcCreateActivities after the loop, keeping DML out of the loop.
assignments.name: asgQueueActivityGoal
assignments.label: Queue Activity (Goal Definition)

assignments.description: Prepares an Outcome Activity linked to the selected Program: sets Name, OutcomeActivityType and OutcomeId, sets ProgramId from the repeater row, clears the other two lookups so no value carries over from the previous row, then adds the record to colActivitiesToCreate. Records are saved together by rcCreateActivities after the loop, keeping DML out of the loop.
assignments.name: asgQueueActivityProgram
assignments.label: Queue Activity (Program)

assignments.description: Sets colISAIds -= {!varISAToRelink.Id}; varISACount -= 1; varRelinkCount += 1. Keeps the review table and the Success summary in line with the deleted assignment, and the relink count sends the user back to scrReviewStrategy. colExistingISAIds and varExistingISACount are not changed: only assignments created in this session can be removed, and the summary looks records up by ID, so a deleted ID is not shown.
assignments.name: asgRemoveDeletedISA
assignments.label: Remove Deleted Assignment From Session

assignments.description: Sets varOutcomeEditCount = 0; varActivityEditCount = 0; clears colOutcomesToUpdate, colActivitiesToUpdate, colSelectedOutcomes and colSelectedActivities, then re-runs getCreatedOutcomes so scrReview shows the saved changes.
assignments.name: asgResetReviewEdits
assignments.label: Reset Review Edits

assignments.description: Sets varStrategyEditCount = 0; varRelinkCount = 0; clears colStrategiesToUpdate, colSelectedStrategies and colSelectedISAsToRelink, then goes back to decHasStrategyItemsToReview, which re-runs getCreatedISA so scrReviewStrategy shows the saved changes, or skips to the summary when every assignment was removed and there is no new strategy to review.
assignments.name: asgResetStrategyReviewEdits
assignments.label: Reset Strategy Review Edits

choices.name: choiceRelinkOutcome
choices.choiceText: Link it to a different outcome

choices.name: choiceReviewCancel
choices.choiceText: Cancel — delete all records from this session

choices.name: choiceStrategyNone
choices.choiceText: Confirm — but no Strategy linking needed

decisions.description: Routes on: "Benefit" when loopActivities.inpActivityType = "Benefit" -> asgQueueActivityBenefit; "Goal Definition" when loopActivities.inpActivityType = "Goal Definition" -> asgQueueActivityGoal; "Program (default)" otherwise -> asgQueueActivityProgram.
decisions.name: decActivityFieldRoute
decisions.label: Activity Field Route

decisions.description: Routes on: "Yes — Add Another" when inpAddAnother = "Yes" -> scrOutcome; "No / Done" otherwise -> getCreatedOutcomes.
decisions.name: decAddAnother
decisions.label: Add Another Outcome?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Succeeded" when varSubflowSucceeded = true -> scrCancelled; "Failed" otherwise -> scrError.
decisions.name: decCleanupSucceeded
decisions.label: Session Cleanup Succeeded?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Succeeded" when varSubflowSucceeded = true -> asgAppendStrategyAssignmentOutputs; "Failed" otherwise -> scrError.
decisions.name: decCreateAssignmentsSucceeded
decisions.label: Strategy Assignments Created?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Has Edits" when varActivityEditCount > 0.0 -> ruEditedActivities; "No Edits" otherwise -> decReturnToReview.
decisions.name: decDidEditActivities
decisions.label: Any Edited Activities To Save?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Has Edits" when varOutcomeEditCount > 0.0 -> ruEditedOutcomes; "No Edits" otherwise -> loopEditActivities.
decisions.name: decDidEditOutcomes
decisions.label: Any Edited Outcomes To Save?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Has Edits" when varStrategyEditCount > 0.0 -> ruEditedStrategies; "No Edits" otherwise -> loopRelinkISAs.
decisions.name: decDidEditStrategies
decisions.label: Any Edited Strategies To Save?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Duplicate Found" when getDuplicateRelinkISA.Id is null false -> scrDuplicateRelink; "No Duplicate" otherwise -> asgSetReplacementOutcome.
decisions.name: decDuplicateRelink
decisions.label: Would Relink Create A Duplicate?

decisions.description: Checks whether any activities were queued by loopActivities. If colActivitiesToCreate has records, routes to rcCreateActivities; otherwise continues to decAddAnother.
decisions.name: decHasActivitiesToCreate
decisions.label: Has Activities to Create?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Has Records" when varNewOutcomeCount > 0 or varActivityCount > 0 -> scrReview; "Nothing To Review" otherwise -> scrStrategy (only existing outcomes were picked and no activities were created, so linking a strategy is the only action left).
decisions.name: decHasRecordsToReview
decisions.label: Anything To Review?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Has Items To Review" when varISACount > 0 or varNewStrategyCount > 0 -> getCreatedISA (strategy review screen); "Nothing To Review" otherwise -> asgBuildSummaryISAIds. Nothing is reviewed when every selected outcome was already linked to the chosen strategy, because no assignment or strategy was created in this session.
decisions.name: decHasStrategyItemsToReview
decisions.label: Anything To Review After Linking?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Yes, Link" when inpLinkActivities = {!choiceLinkActivityYes} -> loopActivities; "Don't Link" otherwise -> decAddAnother.
decisions.name: decLinkActivities
decisions.label: Link Activities?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Yes — Link Another" when inpLinkAnotherStrategy = "Yes" -> scrStrategy; "No — Done" otherwise -> decHasStrategyItemsToReview.
decisions.name: decLinkAnotherStrategy
decisions.label: Link Another Strategy?

decisions.description: Routes on: "New Outcome" when inpOutcomeChoice = "New" -> rcCreateOutcome; "Existing" otherwise -> asgSetExistingOutcomeId.
decisions.name: decOutcomeNewOrExisting
decisions.label: New or Existing Outcome?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Confirm — Link Strategy" when inpReviewAction = "Confirm" -> scrStrategy; "Skip Strategy" otherwise -> subBuildSummaryWithoutStrategy. Reached from decReviewAction after scrReviewNextStep.
decisions.name: decPostReviewRoute
decisions.label: Continue To Strategy Linking?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Remove Link" when inpRelinkAction = "Remove" -> rdSessionISA; "Relink" otherwise -> decReplacementChanged.
decisions.name: decRelinkAction
decisions.label: Relink Or Remove?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Same Outcome" when inpReplacementOutcome = {!varISAToRelink.OutcomeId} -> scrSameOutcomeRelink; "Different Outcome" otherwise -> getValidatedReplacementOutcome.
decisions.name: decReplacementChanged
decisions.label: Was A Replacement Outcome Selected?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Edits Saved" when varOutcomeEditCount > 0 or varActivityEditCount > 0 -> asgResetReviewEdits (back to scrReview); "No Edits" otherwise -> scrReviewNextStep, where the user chooses what to do next.
decisions.name: decReturnToReview
decisions.label: Any Review Edits Saved?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Edits Saved" when varStrategyEditCount > 0 or varRelinkCount > 0 -> asgResetStrategyReviewEdits (back to scrReviewStrategy); "No Edits" otherwise -> asgBuildSummaryISAIds.
decisions.name: decReturnToStrategyReview
decisions.label: Any Strategy Review Edits Saved?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Confirm" when inpReviewAction = "Confirm" -> decPostReviewRoute; "No Strategy Needed" when inpReviewAction = {!choiceStrategyNone} -> decPostReviewRoute; "Cancel" otherwise -> subCleanUpSession. Reached from scrReviewNextStep.
decisions.name: decReviewAction
decisions.label: Review Action

decisions.description: Routes on: "Use Existing Strategy" when inpStrategyChoice = "Existing" -> asgSetExistingStrategyId; "Create New Strategy (Default)" otherwise -> rcCreateImpactStrategy.
decisions.name: decStrategyAction
decisions.label: Strategy Action

decisions.description: Routes on: "Succeeded" when varSubflowSucceeded = true -> scrSuccess; "Failed" otherwise -> scrError.
decisions.name: decSummaryAfterReviewSucceeded
decisions.label: Session Summary Succeeded After Review?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Succeeded" when varSubflowSucceeded = true -> scrSuccess; "Failed" otherwise -> scrError.
decisions.name: decSummaryWithoutStrategySucceeded
decisions.label: Session Summary Succeeded Without Strategy?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Valid" when getValidatedISAToRelink.Id is null false -> asgLoadISAToRelink; "Invalid Selection" otherwise -> scrError.
decisions.name: decValidatedISAToRelink
decisions.label: Selected Strategy Assignment Valid?

decisions.description: Routes on: "Valid" when getValidatedReplacementOutcome.Id is null false -> getDuplicateRelinkISA; "Invalid Selection" otherwise -> scrError.
decisions.name: decValidatedReplacementOutcome
decisions.label: Replacement Outcome Valid?

Flow.description: Guided screen-flow wizard for building an organisation's Outcome / Impact Strategy hierarchy: define or select Outcomes, link them to Programs/Benefits/Goal Definitions as Outcome Activities, optionally group them under an Impact Strategy, review/edit everything created in the session (including relinking or removing strategy assignments), and confirm. Requires Nonprofit Cloud with Program & Outcome Management enabled (uses the standard Outcome, ImpactStrategy, ImpactStrategyAssignment, OutcomeActivity, Benefit, Program and GoalDefinition objects). Split into 3 subflows for maintainability: Outcome_Strategy_Create_Strategy_Assignments (creates missing ImpactStrategyAssignment records), Outcome_Strategy_Build_Session_Summary (builds the read-only review/success summary HTML), and Outcome_Strategy_Clean_Up_Session (deletes session-created records on cancel).
Flow.label: Outcome Strategy Builder

loops.description: Iterates over {!repeaterActivities.AllItems} (Asc order); each item is sent to decActivityFieldRoute, and once exhausted the loop exits to decHasActivitiesToCreate, which saves all queued activities in a single Create Records element.
loops.name: loopActivities
loops.label: Loop Over Activities

loops.description: Iterates over the newly created records in {!colActivitiesToCreate}; each item is sent to asgStoreCreatedActivityId, and once exhausted the loop exits to asgClearActivitiesToCreate. Contains assignments only (no DML or queries).
loops.name: loopCreatedActivities
loops.label: Loop Created Activities

loops.description: Iterates over {!colSelectedActivities} (Asc order); each item is sent to asgLoadActivityToEdit, and once exhausted the loop exits to decDidEditActivities.
loops.name: loopEditActivities
loops.label: Loop Edit Activities

loops.description: Iterates over {!colSelectedOutcomes} (Asc order); each item is sent to asgLoadOutcomeToEdit, and once exhausted the loop exits to decDidEditOutcomes.
loops.name: loopEditOutcomes
loops.label: Loop Edit Outcomes

loops.description: Iterates over {!colSelectedStrategies} (Asc order); each item is sent to asgLoadStrategyToEdit, and once exhausted the loop exits to decDidEditStrategies.
loops.name: loopEditStrategies
loops.label: Loop Edit Strategies

loops.description: Iterates over {!colSelectedISAsToRelink} (Asc order); each item is sent to getValidatedISAToRelink, and once exhausted the loop exits to decReturnToStrategyReview, which loops back to scrReviewStrategy if anything was edited or relinked. Note for reviewers: the query inside this loop is intentional. The loop contains screens, so each iteration runs in its own transaction and governor limits reset; the query re-validates the record after the user has viewed it so the flow never acts on stale data.
loops.name: loopRelinkISAs
loops.label: Loop Strategy Assignments To Relink

recordCreates.description: Creates all Outcome Activity records queued in colActivitiesToCreate in a single DML operation. Salesforce populates the Id on each record in the collection, which loopCreatedActivities then collects. On failure, routes to scrError.
recordCreates.name: rcCreateActivities
recordCreates.label: Create Activities

recordCreates.description: Create a new ImpactStrategy record setting Description={!inpNewStrategyDescription}; Level={!inpNewStrategyLevel}; Name={!inpNewStrategyName}; Status="Planned"; Type={!inpNewStrategyType}. On failure, routes to scrError.
recordCreates.name: rcCreateImpactStrategy
recordCreates.label: Create Impact Strategy

recordCreates.description: Create a new Outcome record setting Description={!inpOutcomeDescription}; IntendedDirection={!inpOutcomeDirection}; Name={!inpOutcomeName}; SourceName={!inpOutcomeSource}; Status={!inpOutcomeStatus}; Term={!inpOutcomeTerm}. On failure, routes to scrError.
recordCreates.name: rcCreateOutcome
recordCreates.label: Create Outcome

recordDeletes.description: Delete the assignment the user chose to remove on scrRelinkISA. Only assignments created in this session can reach this step, because getValidatedISAToRelink checks the record is in colISAIds. The outcome and the impact strategy are not deleted.
recordDeletes.name: rdSessionISA
recordDeletes.label: Delete Session Strategy Assignment

recordLookups.description: Get the ImpactStrategyAssignment records created in this run, for read-only context on the strategy review screen. Only reached when at least one ISA was created.
recordLookups.name: getCreatedISA
recordLookups.label: Get Created ISA

recordLookups.description: Get all newly created outcome activities to surface in the review screen
recordLookups.name: getCreatedOutcomeActivities
recordLookups.label: Get Created Outcome Activities

recordLookups.description: Get all newly created outcomes to surface in the review screen
recordLookups.name: getCreatedOutcomes
recordLookups.label: Get Created Outcomes

recordLookups.description: Query ImpactStrategyAssignment for the first matching record where OutcomeId = {!getValidatedReplacementOutcome.Id}; ImpactStrategyId = {!varISAToRelink.ImpactStrategyId}; Id != {!varISAToRelink.Id} (logic: 1 AND 2 AND 3). On failure, routes to scrError.
recordLookups.name: getDuplicateRelinkISA
recordLookups.label: Get Duplicate Relink Assignment

recordLookups.description: Get only the Outcomes actually created in this run (not pre-existing Outcomes the user selected/linked to) so the review screen never lets a user accidentally modify a record they didn't create. Runs before decHasRecordsToReview, which shows scrReview only when there is something to review (Phase A editing).
recordLookups.name: getNewOutcomesForReview
recordLookups.label: Get New Outcomes For Review

recordLookups.description: Get only the Impact Strategy records actually created in this run (not pre-existing strategies the user linked to) so the strategy review screen never lets a user accidentally modify a record they didn't create.
recordLookups.name: getNewStrategiesForEdit
recordLookups.label: Get New Strategies For Edit

recordLookups.description: Query ImpactStrategyAssignment for the first matching record where Id = {!loopRelinkISAs.Id}; Id in {!colISAIds}. Retrieves Id, OutcomeId, ImpactStrategyId. On failure, routes to scrError. Note for reviewers: the query inside this loop is intentional. The loop contains screens, so each iteration runs in its own transaction and governor limits reset; the query re-validates the record after the user has viewed it so the flow never acts on stale data.
recordLookups.name: getValidatedISAToRelink
recordLookups.label: Validate Selected Strategy Assignment

recordLookups.description: Query Outcome for the first matching record where Id = {!inpReplacementOutcome}; Id in {!colOutcomeIds}. Retrieves Id. On failure, routes to scrError.
recordLookups.name: getValidatedReplacementOutcome
recordLookups.label: Validate Replacement Outcome

recordUpdates.description: Persist edits made via the select-then-loop-edit screen for Outcome Activities (scrEditActivity). Only reached when varActivityEditCount > 0, so this never runs against an empty collection. Continues to decReturnToReview, which loops back to scrReview.
recordUpdates.name: ruEditedActivities
recordUpdates.label: Update Edited Activities

recordUpdates.description: Persist edits made via the select-then-loop-edit screen for Outcomes (scrEditOutcome). Only reached when varOutcomeEditCount > 0, so this never runs against an empty collection.
recordUpdates.name: ruEditedOutcomes
recordUpdates.label: Update Edited Outcomes

recordUpdates.description: Persist edits made via the select-then-loop-edit screen for Impact Strategies (scrEditStrategy). Only reached when varStrategyEditCount > 0, so this never runs against an empty collection.
recordUpdates.name: ruEditedStrategies
recordUpdates.label: Update Edited Strategies

recordUpdates.description: Relink the selected existing assignment by changing only OutcomeId. The assignment Id and ImpactStrategyId are preserved.
recordUpdates.name: ruRelinkedISA
recordUpdates.label: Update Relinked Strategy Assignment

screens.description: A welcome screen before the start of the builder to ensure users have all the information needed to create the records.
screens.name: scrWelcome
screens.label: Welcome

fields.name: dispWelcomeHeader
fields.fieldText:
This guided setup helps you define your organisation's outcomes and connect them to the programs and services that drive change.


By the end of this setup, you'll have created:

  • Outcomes (optional) - The changes you want to see happen - e.g., "Increase financial literacy among participants"
  • Outcome Activities - Link newly created or existing outcomes to programs, benefits, or goals driving each outcome (you can link multiple) - e.g., "Deliver financial literacy workshops" → Financial Literacy Program
  • Impact Strategy (optional) - Link one or more strategic frameworks grouping your outcomes - e.g., "Financial Wellbeing Strategy 2026"

fields.name: dispVisualExample
fields.fieldText:
Example — Financial Support Services:


Strategy: "Financial Wellbeing Strategy 2026"

  ↳ Outcome: "Increase financial literacy among participants" (Increase, Medium-Term)

    ↳ Activity: "Deliver financial literacy workshops" → Program: Financial Literacy Program

    ↳ Activity: "Provide 1-on-1 budgeting coaching" → Benefit: Financial Coaching Benefit

    ↳ Activity: "Achieve debt-free status" → Goal: Debt Freedom Goal

  ↳ Outcome: "Maintain housing stability for at-risk clients" (Maintain, Short-Term)

    ↳ Activity: "Provide emergency hardship grants" → Benefit: Emergency Financial Assistance

fields.name: dispWhatToHaveReady
fields.fieldText:
What to have ready before you start:

• Your organisation's theory of change, logic model, or strategic plan

• A list of the outcomes (changes) your organisation wants to achieve

• Active programs, benefits, or goals your organisation runs that drive those outcomes exist in your Salesforce environment

fields.name: dispSaveAsYouGo
fields.fieldText: ⓘ Good to know: your outcomes and activities are saved as you go. To discard them, choose Cancel on the Review screen. If you close this window part-way through, the records created so far are kept and can be removed later by your administrator.

subflows.description: Calls subflow Outcome_Strategy_Build_Session_Summary, which builds the read-only Strategy/Outcome/Activity summary HTML shown to the user. Passes in: inOutcomeIds, inActivityIds, inAssignmentIds (colSummaryISAIds: links created in this session plus links that already existed). Captures outputs: outSummaryHtml->varSuccessHierarchy, outSucceeded->varSubflowSucceeded, outErrorMessage->varSubflowErrorMessage. Error handling: Subflow elements do not support fault paths, so the subflow catches its own faults and returns outSucceeded and outErrorMessage; the following decision routes any failure to scrError, which displays the message.
subflows.name: subBuildSummaryAfterReview
subflows.label: Build Session Summary After Review

subflows.description: Calls subflow Outcome_Strategy_Build_Session_Summary, which builds the read-only Strategy/Outcome/Activity summary HTML shown to the user. Passes in: inOutcomeIds, inActivityIds, inAssignmentIds. Captures outputs: outSummaryHtml->varSuccessHierarchy, outSucceeded->varSubflowSucceeded, outErrorMessage->varSubflowErrorMessage. Error handling: Subflow elements do not support fault paths, so the subflow catches its own faults and returns outSucceeded and outErrorMessage; the following decision routes any failure to scrError, which displays the message.
subflows.name: subBuildSummaryWithoutStrategy
subflows.label: Build Session Summary Without Strategy

subflows.description: Calls subflow Outcome_Strategy_Clean_Up_Session, which deletes session-created activities and outcomes when the user cancels. Passes in: inActivityIds, inNewOutcomeIds. Captures outputs: outDeletedActivityCount->varDeletedActivityCount, outDeletedOutcomeCount->varDeletedOutcomeCount, outSucceeded->varSubflowSucceeded, outErrorMessage->varSubflowErrorMessage. Error handling: Subflow elements do not support fault paths, so the subflow catches its own faults and returns outSucceeded and outErrorMessage; the following decision routes any failure to scrError, which displays the message.
subflows.name: subCleanUpSession
subflows.label: Clean Up Session

subflows.description: Calls subflow Outcome_Strategy_Create_Strategy_Assignments, which creates only the missing ImpactStrategyAssignment records for the supplied outcomes. Passes in: inStrategyId, inOutcomes. Captures outputs: outCreatedAssignmentIds->colSubflowCreatedAssignmentIds, outCreatedCount->varSubflowCreatedAssignmentCount, outSucceeded->varSubflowSucceeded, outErrorMessage->varSubflowErrorMessage. Error handling: Subflow elements do not support fault paths, so the subflow catches its own faults and returns outSucceeded and outErrorMessage; the following decision routes any failure to scrError, which displays the message.
subflows.name: subCreateStrategyAssignments
subflows.label: Create Strategy Assignments

variables.description: IDs of ImpactStrategyAssignment records that already existed for a chosen strategy and outcome, so were not created again. Used only for the summary; they are never edited or deleted.

variables.description: ImpactStrategyAssignment records created in this run, shown read-only on the strategy review screen for context.
variables.name: colISARecords

variables.description: IDs of new Impact Strategy records created in this run (not pre-existing strategies the user linked to).
variables.name: colNewStrategyIds

variables.description: New Impact Strategy records created in this run, editable on the strategy review screen.

variables.name: colOutcomesToUpdate

variables.description: Counts how many Outcome Activity records were actually edited in loopEditActivities, guarding ruEditedActivities against running on an empty collection.

variables.name: varActivityRecord

variables.description: Writable copy of the current loop item in loopEditActivities; loop variables are read-only, so edits happen here before being collected.
variables.name: varActivityToEdit

variables.description: Number of chosen outcome and strategy links that already existed, so no new assignment was created for them. Added up per strategy in asgAppendStrategyAssignmentOutputs as selected outcomes minus created assignments. Shows the "Some links already existed" note on the strategy review and Success screens when greater than 0.
variables.name: varExistingISACount

variables.description: Minimal update record for relinking. Contains only the validated assignment Id and replacement OutcomeId.
variables.name: varISARelinkUpdate

variables.description: Writable copy of the current ImpactStrategyAssignment being relinked. Only OutcomeId is changed.
variables.name: varISAToRelink

variables.description: Counts how many Outcome records were actually edited in loopEditOutcomes, guarding ruEditedOutcomes against running on an empty collection.
variables.name: varOutcomeEditCount

variables.description: Set to true once any outcome is edited in this session. Unlike varOutcomeEditCount, it is never reset. Shows the note under the strategy assignment table explaining that the table may still show an earlier outcome name.
variables.name: varOutcomeRenamed

variables.description: Writable copy of the current loop item in loopEditOutcomes; loop variables are read-only, so edits happen here before being collected.
variables.name: varOutcomeToEdit

variables.description: Counts how many Impact Strategy Assignments were relinked in loopRelinkISAs, so decReturnToStrategyReview knows to return to scrReviewStrategy.
variables.name: varRelinkCount

variables.description: Working count in asgAppendStrategyAssignmentOutputs: the outcomes selected for the current strategy, minus the assignments the subflow created. The result is the number of links that already existed.
variables.name: varSelectedOutcomeCount

variables.description: Counts how many Impact Strategy records were actually edited in loopEditStrategies, guarding ruEditedStrategies against running on an empty collection.
variables.name: varStrategyEditCount

variables.description: Writable copy of the current loop item in loopEditStrategies; loop variables are read-only, so edits happen here before being collected.
